args.title: Announce error toasts assertively and prevent auto-dismissal
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider and Toast so that error toasts use an assertive live region (`aria-live="assertive"`) instead of a polite one, and do not automatically dismiss after 5 seconds, ensuring users have time to read and dismiss error messages.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts should be announced immediately (using an assertive live region) and should not auto-dismiss after five seconds so that users have ample time to read and manually dismiss them.
